title: 第13章 炫耀的师父们第14章 雷灵力如狸奴
slug: 满级雷灵根卷哭修仙界
lines: 次日清晨，天光微亮，栖凤峰还笼罩在薄薄的晨雾中。
两只灵鹤轻盈地降落在主殿前，背上载着两个兴奋的小团子。
“意意师父～”
“凤师叔祖～”
云逸和柳轻舞从灵鹤背上跳下来，迈着小短腿啪嗒啪嗒地跑进殿内。
林枝意正在师父的监督下小心翼翼地练习控制雷灵力，听到小伙伴的声音，立刻分心，掌心的雷球“噗”地一声消散了。
“云逸！轻舞！”小公主开心地跑过去，“你们怎么来啦？”
云逸的小脸上满是兴奋，难得没有掉金豆子“云逸成功啦～昨天晚上成功引气入体的！”
柳轻舞也用力点头，小脸红扑扑的“轻舞也成功了！是在子时之前成功的！”
两个小团子眼巴巴地看向凤临渊，异口同声“奖励呢？”
凤临渊挑眉，看着这两个一大早就来讨债的小家伙“哦？这么快？”
他伸手分别探了探两个孩子的经脉，果然感受到了微弱的灵力流转。
云逸的灵力中带着凛冽的剑意，柳轻舞的则轻盈飘逸，都与他们的灵根特性相符。
“不错，”凤临渊难得地露出赞许的笑容，“既然达成了约定，自然不会亏待你们。”
他挥手间，四道绿光从院中飞出，落在殿内化作四个灵植所化的少女。
两个身着浅蓝衣裙，气质清冷；
两个身着鹅黄衣裙，温柔可人。
“这两个是冰莲所化，适合陪伴云逸修炼。”
凤临渊指向鹅黄衣裙的少女，“这两个是迎春花所化，与轻舞的风灵根相得益彰。”
云逸和柳轻舞惊喜地看着属于自己的灵植侍女，小脸上写满了开心。
“谢谢意意师父！”云逸难得地露出灿烂的笑容。
“谢谢凤师叔祖！”柳轻舞小声地道谢，害羞地躲到了自己的新侍女身后。
而此时此刻，玄天剑派各峰正在上演着与昨日相似的一幕。
剑意峰上，云逸的师父周长老“偶遇”了寒冰峰的李长老
“李师兄，早啊！哎呀，你怎么知道我那个小徒弟云逸引气入体成功了？才三岁的小娃娃，居然要八个时辰才成功，真是太笨了！”
李长老嘴角抽搐“”他并没问啊！
流云峰上，柳轻舞的师父孙长老“恰好”路过炼丹峰
“赵师弟，教导弟子呢？我家那个小轻舞啊，天赋也就一般，都三岁了，居然要七个多时辰才引气入体成功，真是让人操心！”
赵长老“”谁问你了？！
主峰膳堂内，两位长老的声音格外洪亮
content_en:
The next morning, the sky was slightly bright, and Qifeng Peak was still shrouded in a thin morning mist.
Two cranes landed lightly in front of the main hall, carrying two excited little dumplings on their backs.
"Master Yiyi~"
"Uncle Fengshi~"
Yun Yi and Liu Qingwu jumped off Linghe's back and ran into the hall with their short legs.
Lin Zhiyi was carefully practicing controlling the power of thunder under the supervision of his master. Hearing the voice of his friend, he was immediately distracted and the thunder ball in his palm dissipated with a pop.
"Yun Yi! Qing Wu!" The little princess ran over happily, "Why are you here?"
Yun Yi's little face was full of excitement, and it was rare that he didn't drop the golden beans. "Yun Yi succeeded~ He successfully introduced Qi into his body last night!"
Liu Qingwu also nodded vigorously, her face flushed, "Qingwu also succeeded! She succeeded before Zi Shi!"
The two little dumplings looked at Feng Linyuan eagerly and said in unison, "Where's the reward?"
Feng Linyuan raised his eyebrows and looked at the two little guys who came to collect debts early in the morning, "Oh? So soon?"
He stretched out his hand to explore the meridians of the two children, and sure enough he felt a faint flow of spiritual power.
Yun Yi's spiritual power carries a sharp sword intent, while Liu Qingwu's is light and elegant, both of which are consistent with the characteristics of their spiritual roots.
"That's right," Feng Linyuan showed a rare smile of approval, "Since we have reached an agreement, I will naturally not treat you badly."
As he waved his hand, four rays of green light flew out from the courtyard, landed in the hall and transformed into four girls transformed from spiritual plants.
The two were dressed in light blue dresses and had a cool temperament;
The two were dressed in goose-yellow dresses, gentle and lovely.
"These two are transformed from ice lotus and are suitable to accompany Yun Yi in his cultivation."
Feng Linyuan pointed to the girl in a goose-yellow dress, "These two are transformed from winter jasmine flowers, and they complement the lightly dancing wind spirit roots."
Yun Yi and Liu Qingwu looked at their own spiritual plant maids in surprise, with happiness written all over their faces.
"Thank you, Master Yiyi!" Yun Yi showed a rare bright smile.
"Thank you, Uncle Feng!" Liu Qingwu thanked her quietly and shyly hid behind her new maid.
At this moment, the peaks of the Xuantian Sword Sect were performing scenes similar to yesterday.
On Jianyi Peak, Yun Yi's master, Elder Zhou, "encountered" Elder Li from Ice Peak.
"Good morning, Senior Brother Li! Oops, how do you know that my little apprentice Yun Yi successfully introduced Qi into his body? It took eight hours for a three-year-old baby to succeed. How stupid!"
Elder Li's mouth twitched. "He didn't ask!"
On Liuyun Peak, Liu Qingwu’s master, Elder Sun, “happened” to pass by Alchemy Peak.
"Junior Brother Zhao, where are you teaching your disciples? My little Qingwu has only average talent. He is three years old. It actually takes more than seven hours to successfully introduce Qi into the body. It's really worrying!"
Elder Zhao ""Who asked you? !
In the dining hall of the main peak, the voices of the two elders were particularly loud.
